convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator 'MA_Rounding_Candle' which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, plus two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) that provide trading logic and smoothing algorithms. The custom indicator's buffer values drive all entry/exit signals.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars before indicator is valid

other_exits: Opposite trend signal closes position: TrendValue==2 closes sell, TrendValue==0 closes buy

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM parameter (0.1) is the fraction or lot depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses custom indicator buffer 4 (index 4) which outputs trend state values: 0=downtrend, 2=uptrend. The EA reads 2 consecutive values from this buffer (bars SignalBar and SignalBar+1). A buy signal requires TrendValue[1]==2 (current trend is up) AND TrendValue[0]<2 (previous trend was not up, i.e. crossover/trend change). A sell signal requires TrendValue[1]==0 AND TrendValue[0]>0. The signal time is set to the last bar date plus one timeframe period, effectively targeting next bar open. BuyPosOpen/SellPosClose/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose are independent boolean toggles allowing selective enable/disable of each direction's entry and exit. GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: The MA_Rounding_Candle custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses the CXMA smoothing library from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which supports 9 methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). The rounding logic (MaRound=50) rounds MA values to a multiple of the rounding factor. The trend state is derived from comparing rounded candle values. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with position gate logic and money management. The multi-mode position sizing (LOT vs margin-based) must be replicated. Signal bar parameter allows backtesting on confirmed bars (default bar 1 = last closed bar). No digit adjustment needed as SL/TP are in points already.
